comments: Gate 2 approved. Option A selected for the two report-API scenarios: TS-EC-11358-006 (eoRequestExport) and TS-EC-11358-007 (eoGetDocumentActivityHistoryReport) are ratified as HUMAN_APPROVED on the strength of the EC-11358 story (which explicitly verified both APIs) and the form-POST .eo pattern in reports/validation/ecore-api-discovery.json. PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION must confirm the live request/response shape and record any discrepancy against this approved contract; a discrepancy is a finding, never a silent edit.
